_comments: DEFAULT. Fewer cut-ins at almost the same median. Deepgram Flux eotThreshold 0.8 (Deepgram: 0.8-0.9 = 'higher certainty required before ending a turn, fewer false positives, slightly increased latency'), eotTimeoutMs 4000 (a caller can pause up to 4 s mid-thought before Flux forces a turn end; was 3000), waitSeconds 0.2 (was 0.3: once Flux is confident the caller is done, extra fixed wait only adds latency). Oct 21 morning call on 0.7 / 3000 / 0.3: median 1504 ms, 1 cut-in, after a complete question ('What'd you say?') followed by more speech: the case a higher confidence threshold targets.
